label: AppInstall Pro
summary: A curated application installation product with complete versioned recipes: requirements, trusted upstream artifacts, compatible runtime/database combinations, scoped configuration, install, update, backup, restore and dependency-aware removal. The 410 editorial references are discovery input; each deliverable recipe requires independent qualification and upstream license review.
core_boundary: Core retains all 233 essential capabilities, application/resource ownership, ordinary hosting, local backup/recovery and the seven engine adapters. AppInstall Pro adds qualified optional application recipes and orchestration through detached extension contracts; it creates no privileged executor, legal compatibility decision or automatic installability for catalogue entries.
acceptance: Qualify each offered recipe on an explicit application/version/OS/architecture/runtime/database/provider matrix; unsupported combinations must remain unavailable.
Pin and verify upstream sources and recipe artifacts, record the applicable upstream licenses and redistribution/source obligations, and refuse unreviewed artifacts or incompatible combinations.
Exercise fresh install, interrupted install, update, supported rollback, backup/restore and removal with owned writable paths, secret references, data retention and per-instance results.
Run dependency installers as the application identity through admitted operations; deny arbitrary executable hooks, shell text, tenant escapes and access to Core credentials.
Demonstrate that removing or disabling AppInstall Pro preserves installed applications, canonical resource inventory, local recovery and access through the free Core.
